name: Arkham Intel (x402)
instructions_text: Arkham wallet intelligence: pre-trade due diligence, counterparty and smart-money analysis, balances, portfolios, flows, token/market data, and Polymarket activity. All routes are POST with JSON body fields (path parameters become body fields; EVM addresses are lowercased). $0.20 per credit; per-row endpoints (transfers, swaps) price from `limit` — pass the smallest useful limit. Rate limits: 100 req/s per wallet on most endpoints, 5 req/s on heavy ones (transfers, swaps, token/top, counterparties, flow, search). Failed upstream requests are not charged.
